intent.proves: At least one dynamic workspace has a level.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DynamicStructures s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DynamicStructureLevels l WHERE l.DynamicStructureLevelStructureId = CAST(s.DynamicStructureUniqueId AS nvarchar(50)))
